name: Rich Text Notes Editor
summary: Rich text notes CodeComponent powered by TipTap editor. Uses TipTap.useEditor with TipTap.StarterKit, TipTap.Placeholder, and TipTap.Link extensions. TipTap.EditorContent renders the WYSIWYG editor. Formatting toolbar with ButtonGroup for bold, italic, heading (H1-H3), bullet list, ordered list, blockquote, and code block. Link insertion via Dialog with URL input. Word count and character count displayed in footer. Save button triggers useHandler('saveNote') with toast. Author shown from useCurrentUser. useAppState persists editor HTML content. Uses TipTap.useEditor, TipTap.EditorContent, Card, Button, ButtonGroup, Dialog, Input, Label, Separator, Badge, and Icons from the SDK.
shortSummary: TipTap rich text editor with formatting toolbar, link dialog, word count, and save handler
